_about: F35: one story moment per rank-up (design/story.md "Story moments, rank by rank"), played at the console between shifts, once per device (Settings → Replay lessons plays them again). Each line: voice mon = Management types it on the monitor · spk = the Veteran's talking bubble over the monitor (Management can cut in: a mon line in the middle of his). words = a key in content/text/en.json story.lines. look = a console part to outline while the moment plays (optional; a part that isn't on the console yet is just left out). F40 (ranks 10–30) — a line can also have: monitor = what the monitor does while the line is up ('flicker' = it heard that · 'alarm' = it flashes red, the capture at 30) · crackle = the Veteran's bubble squelches more often while it waits (looks.crackleEvery) · cut = the line is cut off: once it has typed out, the moment moves on by itself after looks.cutSeconds (no tap). Looks on the tank (eyes at 10/11/24, a whisper at 15/27, the pressure line at 18, a multi-colour piece at 20, cracks at 22) wait for those pieces (F62 eyes…) — the words play now.
_looks: F40: the numbers of the story looks. flickerSeconds = how long the monitor flickers · alarmSeconds = one red flash of the alarm (it flashes while the line is up) · alarmColour = the red · crackleEvery = seconds between the bubble's squelches on a crackle line (talk.json squelchEvery is the usual) · cutSeconds = how long a cut line stays once typed out before the next line takes over.
_catchUp: Most moments played in one visit to the console (the newest ones), e.g. after two rank-ups in one shift or on a device that skipped some.
_whispers: In-shift whispers (design/story.md: 3 '…cold…' — one you'll doubt, once per device · 8+ one feeling a shift). A plain bubble pointing into the tank; no tap, it goes by itself. Seconds are rules time (pauses stop them). Words: en.json story.whispers.
